genes.name: major histocompatibility complex, class II, DR beta 1
genes.function: MHC class II antigen-presentation allele that presents mycobacterial peptides to CD4 T cells.
genes.disease_evidence: HLA-DRB1 polymorphisms are associated with tuberculosis susceptibility.

genes.name: interferon gamma
genes.function: Type II interferon that activates macrophages and coordinates granuloma formation.
genes.disease_evidence: IFNG variants are associated with tuberculosis susceptibility.

genes.name: interferon gamma receptor 1
genes.function: Ligand-binding subunit of the interferon-gamma receptor.
genes.disease_evidence: IFNGR1 variants impair mycobacterial immunity and are associated with tuberculosis.

genes.name: interleukin 12 subunit beta
genes.function: IL-12 p40 subunit that drives Th1 and interferon-gamma responses.
genes.disease_evidence: IL12B polymorphisms are associated with tuberculosis risk.

genes.name: interleukin 12 receptor subunit beta 1
genes.function: IL-12 receptor subunit required for Th1 differentiation and interferon-gamma production.
genes.disease_evidence: IL12RB1 deficiency causes Mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial disease.

genes.name: tumor necrosis factor
genes.function: Pro-inflammatory cytokine required for granuloma formation and mycobacterial containment.
genes.disease_evidence: TNF is central to tuberculosis granuloma integrity and host defense.

genes.name: vitamin D receptor
genes.function: Nuclear receptor that regulates antimicrobial peptide expression and macrophage function.
genes.disease_evidence: VDR variants are associated with tuberculosis susceptibility.

genes.name: solute carrier family 11 member 1
genes.function: NRAMP1 metal transporter involved in macrophage iron and manganese handling.
genes.disease_evidence: SLC11A1 polymorphisms are associated with tuberculosis susceptibility.
